criteria.requirement: The 3D wheel has distinguishable tire, tube, rim, spokes, hub and valve, with a cutaway explaining the tube position.
criteria.action: Inspect the wheel and activate its cutaway.
criteria.expected: Tire, inner tube, rim, spokes, hub and valve are distinguishable; the tube sits inside the tire.

criteria.requirement: The lesson covers deflate, unseat bead, remove tube, locate puncture, patch and reassemble, each with matching visible model change and instruction.
criteria.action: Progress through deflation, bead removal, tube removal, puncture location, patching and reassembly.
criteria.expected: Each repair step has a short instruction and a corresponding model change.

criteria.requirement: The learner can pause, rotate the wheel and revisit steps while labels remain attached to the correct components.
criteria.action: Pause the lesson, rotate the wheel and revisit a previous step.
criteria.expected: Playback can pause and resume exploration; labels remain attached to the correct parts.

criteria.requirement: A practice round asks for part identification and repair-step ordering, gives mistake feedback and permits retry.
criteria.action: Complete part-identification and step-ordering practice with an incorrect answer, then retry.
criteria.expected: Both practice types provide mistake feedback and allow another attempt.

criteria.requirement: Tablet/mobile controls and labels remain large and usable beside the work area.
criteria.action: Use the lesson at a tablet-sized viewport and inspect labels during rotation.
criteria.expected: Controls are large enough to operate and labels remain readable beside the working area.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the labeled wheel, cutaway and component relationships.
Walk through all repair stages, compare model states and revisit a prior step.
Make a mistake in part/ordering practice, inspect feedback and retry; rotate the wheel while checking label attachment.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
